bio: Mt. Everest Real-Estate is a premier land development and property advisory firm in Nepal. For over a decade, we have pioneered planned land plotting, master-planned residential colonies, and strategic commercial land acquisitions. With 100% verified cadastral boundaries, transparent legal documentation, and road connectivity, we empower families and investors to secure prime land with absolute peace of mind.
